subject: Warehouse team Christmas do
body:
Hi,

We'd like to book our Christmas do for the warehouse and office team, 110 people. Festive dinner and then dancing till midnight.

Thanks,
Dev

subject: Allotment society AGM
body:
Hello,

Green Lane Allotment Society would like a room for our AGM, usually about 65 plot holders. Chair's report, accounts and a vote on the new rules. One member gets about on a mobility scooter.

Brian Hollis

subject: London Hospitality Awards
body:
Hi there,

We're planning the London Hospitality Awards for 160 guests. Two-course dinner, a host on stage, short nominee videos before each category and winners coming up to collect.

Lucy

subject: Rotary quiz night
body:
Good evening,

Our Rotary club is holding a quiz night fundraiser, ten teams of five. Fish and chip supper at half time, and the bar open throughout.

Regards

subject: Memorial gathering for my grandmother
body:
Hello,

We're holding a memorial gathering for my grandmother, about 90 family and friends. Somewhere to share memories over a buffet. My uncle uses a wheelchair.

Thank you,
Grace

subject: Women in Fintech mixer
body:
Hi!

Women in Fintech London runs a quarterly mixer, around 75 people. Purely social, people just come to meet each other after work.

Sana

subject: Leadership course
body:
Hello,

We're running a two-day leadership course for 18 managers. The facilitator presents from slides for most of it. Lunch and refreshments both days.

Tom

subject: Rugby club ceilidh
body:
Hi,

The veterans' rugby section would like to hold a ceilidh, 120 players and partners. Stovies supper, then the band.

Callum

subject: Gin brand launch
body:
Hello,

Juniper & Co is launching our first gin and we'd love to host 130 trade guests and press. Our founder will say a few words, then cocktails and canapés.

Mia

subject: Whisky tasting evening
body:
Dear team,

We'd like to host a whisky tasting for 35 members of our cask club. Our master blender leads the tasting from the front; guests seated with water and oatcakes.

Alasdair

subject: Annual shareholder meeting
body:
Hello,

Northgate Homes plc needs a venue for its annual shareholder meeting. We expect around 200 shareholders. The CEO and CFO will present the year on slides followed by questions.

Priya Raman
Company Secretary

subject: Team Christmas party
body:
Hi,

We're a small agency, 45 of us. Christmas dinner and we'll want some music and a bit of a dance afterwards.

Jess

subject: Apprentice of the year evening
body:
Hello,

We hold an apprentice of the year evening for about 90 apprentices, mentors and families. Our MD hands out the certificates and the top award. Buffet afterwards.

Karen

subject: Engagement celebration
body:
Hi,

My fiancée and I want an engagement celebration for about 100 guests. Drinks, a DJ and lots of mingling, no sit-down meal.

Omar

subject: Wedding reception
body:
Hello!

We're getting married in July and looking for a reception venue for 130 guests. Wedding breakfast, speeches, then a live band for dancing. My aunt uses a walker.

Ellie

subject: Python meetup
body:
Hey,

PyData London meetup, usually around 90. Three short talks with slides, then drinks and people stay to chat.

Kofi

subject: Wake after a funeral
body:
Hello, we need a room for a wake after my brother's funeral next week. About 40 people. Tea, coffee and sandwiches.

Sheila

subject: Members' meeting
body:
Hello,

Unity Credit Union's annual members' meeting, roughly 140 members. The board presents on slides and members vote. Several members need step-free access.

Daniel

subject: Cricket club awards dinner
body:
Hi,

Oakfield CC end of season awards dinner, about 100 members and families. Captain hands out the trophies after dinner, then a disco.

Steve

subject: Chamber networking evening
body:
Dear events team,

Southbank Chamber of Commerce would like to hold a networking evening for 180 members. A short welcome from our president, then the evening is for networking. Wine and canapés.

Helen

subject: Dad's 70th birthday lunch
body:
Hi,

We'd like to book a sit-down lunch for Dad's 70th, 70 guests. Nothing rowdy, no dancing. Grandad is in a wheelchair.

Ruth

subject: Trustee strategy day
body:
Hello,

Our 10 trustees need a room for a strategy day. The CEO presents in the morning, discussion in the afternoon.

Amir

subject: Hospice charity gala
body:
Dear team,

River Hospice's charity gala: 220 guests, champagne reception, dinner, an auction from the stage and then dancing to a live band.

Charlotte

subject: Quiz fundraiser
body:
Hi,

We're running a quiz fundraiser for 80 people in teams of eight. Picture round on the big screen, bar open all night.

Neil

subject: University reunion
body:
Hi there,

Organising a 20-year reunion for our university halls, about 60 people. Buffet, drinks, some music and a lot of catching up.

Jo
